title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We're thrilled to officially launch Spyglass, empowering you with powerful new insights and tools.

title: Enhanced File Management for Your Content
summary: Now you have complete control over your embedded files, with a dedicated management area to organize, upload, and customize their display right within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: We're excited to announce our new public roadmap, giving you a transparent look at what we've shipped, what's next, and what's planned for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes for Effortless Task Management
summary: We've made checkboxes bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable, all while updating their look to seamlessly match our modern design.

title: Seamless Collaborative Editing
summary: Experience effortless teamwork with our enhanced collaboration features, providing clearer real-time updates and a more intuitive editing experience for everyone.

title: Effortless Discovery of Shared Ideas
summary: Easily find and collaborate on shared content with friends and colleagues, ensuring all relevant information is readily accessible to enhance your teamwork.

title: Unlock Noeko in Your Language
summary: Get ready to experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out robust support for a diverse range of international languages.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're thrilled to open-source Noeko, empowering our community with unprecedented control, direct involvement, and transparent collaboration to shape its exciting future.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Effortlessly explore your knowledge and kickstart workflows with new filtering options by tags, time, and shared items in your enhanced Constellation view.

title: Precision Search & Curated Collections
summary: Unleash the full potential of your knowledge base by precisely filtering, sorting, and saving your searches into dynamic, custom collections for instant access.

title: Visualize Your Connections
summary: Visualize your ideas more clearly with enhanced interactive displays for linked notes, offering new ways to view and engage with your content.

title: Noeko Self-Hosting & Flexible Cloud Plans
summary: Soon, you'll be able to deploy Noeko on your own infrastructure or choose from our flexible new cloud-hosted plans, tailored to meet your team's unique needs.

title: Vibrant New Theme Collection
summary: Discover a vibrant collection of beautifully redesigned existing themes and exciting new additions, allowing you to personalize your workspace with stunning visual styles.

title: Intelligent Time-Based Welcomes
summary: We are refining our application's greetings to ensure they always perfectly align with the accurate time of day, providing you with a seamless and truly personalized welcome.

title: Seamless Tag Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged items by performing quick actions like removing, deleting, or viewing them directly within any tag list.

title: Unlock New Content Sources
summary: Effortlessly bring in and interact with a wider variety of your favorite content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text documents, directly within our unified platform.
